https://www.galasystems.com/en/spiralift/#:~:text=The%20Spiralift%20is%20the%20basic,a%20strong%20and%20stable%20column.

 a higher speed with the IL75 is not recommended. It will produce squeaking noises which are noticeable, and will lead to more wear, reducing the life expectancy.
 
Our models that can go faster start at 2500kg capacity and are much bigger, so probably would not be suitable. The only solution I can propose is the IL75 with the speed limited to 0.6m/min
 
For 250kg, you are ok with 2 models MN7 as you indicated.
 
The prototype price for 2x IL75-MN7-100 (1m total travel available) is 1120 € each, EXW our plant in St-Hubert, Quebec, Canada.
 
For a discounted price, it needs to be a minimum of 50 units, at which point the price is 885 € each.
 
Each unit weighs around 10kg. 50 units fit in a crate 45in x 45in x 35in, with a total weight around 800 lbs.
